shennong_chang_baicao.scene_description: in ancient times, people did not know which plants can be eaten, so people often got sick after eating some plants
神农decided to find out which plants are safe to eat and which are not, so he climbed mountains to try different plants
神农tried 夹竹桃 and fainted
a person in blue stopped by and gave灵芝to 神农，神农felt better after eating灵芝
another person in brown came by and had a conversation with 神农
神农takes record of灵芝and夹竹桃

mengmu_san_qian.scene_description: 孟子and孟母lived near a graveyard, and 孟子 imitated how to offer sacrifices every day
孟母 decided to move away from the neighborhood near the graveyard because she thought imitating how to offer sacrifices would have a bad impact on 孟子
孟母moved to the neighborhood near the market, 孟子imitated how to buy and sell every day
孟母 moved from the market to the neighborhood near a school, 孟子started to study every day

chang_e_ben_yue.scene_description: 嫦娥and后羿are fairy gods who can fly
there are 10 suns and it is too hot
the sun god took away 后羿 and嫦娥’s power and they cannot fly
后羿went to 王母’s palace to ask for her help
王母 gave him two pills and told him that taking one pill can make one immortal and taking two pills can make one fly
when后羿 was asleep, 嫦娥 took two pills
嫦娥 flies to the moon and cannot go back, she stays with a rabbit on the moon

zhang_qian_chu_shi_xi_yu.scene_description: 匈奴 often intrudes 汉朝, grabbing the food and attacking the people
汉武帝 ordered 张骞 to lead a delegation to go to 大月氏 to build an alliance to resist 匈奴together, because 大月氏 is a neighbor of 匈奴 and has been attached by 匈奴 in the past
张骞 led a delegation of over 100 people, among whom 甘父 was the guide because he used to be a slave of 匈奴 and got to know the terrain very well
the delegation needs to go through the dessert and when they took a rest one day, 匈奴 suddenly attached them
张骞 was captured and became a slave of匈奴, he had herded sheep for 匈奴 for ten years
one day, when 匈奴 was attacked and there was a chaos, 甘父 found 张骞 and took him to escape
张骞, 甘父 and the rest of the delegation continued their mission and went west

they came to 大宛，another minority tribe, and 大宛’s king wanted to have trade with 汉朝, so he showed 张骞 and his delegation 大宛’s products and palace, equipped them with horses and food, and guided the way to大月氏

张骞 and his delegation finally arrived at 大月氏 and met 大月氏’s queen, 张骞 told her about 汉武帝’s plan of alliance, but 大月氏’s queen rejected, because they have moved to a new place so 匈奴 did not attack them for a long time, and they don’t want to have any war anymore
张骞 and his delegation had to go back to 长安，汉朝’s capital, and there were only 3 persons left when they arrived at 长安
张骞 reported what he saw and learned along this journey, and because of this information, 汉朝 defeated 匈奴

张骞 wrote down what he learned about the West and the route he took become 丝绸之路, and China and the West started to make trade, China’s silk and tea were exported to the West and the fruits and spices from the West were imported to China
the historians recorded 张骞’s story and his great contributions
